verdict.rationale: Pipecat Flows functions explicitly support 'processing data by interfacing with external systems and APIs' mid-conversation and auto-derive function schemas from code, while interruption handling and turn detection docs describe how the pipeline manages timing/dead-air around such calls. Missing for 10: no concrete hands-on example/demo showing latency-masking (e.g., filler speech) during a live API call, and no independent benchmark of perceived dead-air during function execution.
